description: ODC (T coverage): SESSION VARIABLE does not exist in ODC. The public API still offers it - OutSystems.Model.Data.ISessionVariable and IESpace.CreateSessionVariable(bool isReadOnly, name, key), exactly as in SS11 - but the product does not have the feature and the factory refuses on the spot: it is the same pattern as CreateBusinessProcess (API yes, product no). In SS11 the session variable is Traditional Web; ODC has no Traditional Web. Whoever looks for session state in ODC uses a client variable (tests/jobs-odc/security-settings.json). Runs in OdcJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessageInTheOdcLane.
expectError: Session Variable objects can't be children of App objects
